propositions: The batched-map transient recovery test recovers its batched Git walk but then compares the exact SHA against None from a one-shot per-event oracle read, causing flaky assertion failures.
The test oracle defect stems from retrying the broad batched walk but not retrying the narrow per-event equivalence oracle call to resolve_event_commit.
Production resolve_event_commit deliberately returns None for all Git errors, empty results, timeouts, and exceptions, and must retain this fail-closed contract.

The fix adds a test-local bounded _fixture_per_event_commit helper that retries the per-event oracle up to five times, returning only non-None SHA values and raising diagnostics on persistent failure.
All batched/per-event exact-equivalence assertions in the fixture module route through the bounded helper, preserving exact position-to-SHA comparisons without production code changes.
